Come to our splendid newly built treehouse in Tandi, 8kms above Jibhi and get away from it all when you stay under the stars. Nestled high above the clouds, this glass treehouse is a dream woven into the misty mountains of Tandi. 

Perched like a bird’s nest on the edge of a cliff, the treehouse gazes out over endless vistas of pine-streaked forests that melt into the horizon. 

On days when the mist rolls in, it feels as though you’re floating in the clouds, suspended between the sky and earth.

sections.heading: The space
sections.text:
As the first light of dawn gently seeps through the panoramic glass walls, the hills come alive, their breath merging with yours, inviting you to sink into the embrace of this secluded haven. The whispers of the wind through cedar leaves and the steady hum of distant critters create a symphony of stillness, perfect for reflection and restoration. You have to walk 15 minutes to get here. It is easy but there is a walk. 

Imagine waking up in the king-sized bed, soft linens tangled in your legs, as sunlight filters through the treetops, painting the room in hues of golden and green. Every corner of this treehouse is crafted to blur the lines between inside and out, where nature becomes your companion. Yet, despite its wild heart, the treehouse offers every comfort and amenity, ensuring you feel cradled in luxury amidst the untamed wilderness.

Important Features:

- King-Size Bed:🛏️  
Stretch out and sink into the plush comfort, with the hills as your morning view.

- Panoramic Glass Walls:🏡
 Feel as if you're living among the trees, with breathtaking forest and valley views from every corner of the house.

- Wi-Fi Access: 💓
Stay connected to the world, even while escaping into nature.

- Outdoor seating area: 🐛
Step out and breathe in the crisp mountain air as you sip your morning tea or catch a glimpse of the sun dipping below the ridges.

- Fully Equipped Bathroom: 🚽
Featuring hot water and essential toiletries, blending rustic charm with modern convenience.

- Cozy Wooden Interiors: 🪵
Warm, wooden textures harmonise with the forest outside, creating a perfect cocoon of comfort.

- Privacy & Seclusion:💑
Ideal for those looking to escape into serenity, far from the bustling city life.

- Bonfire: 🔥
We will make a warm fire for you and your love.

- Breakfast: 🍳
We will give you yummy breakfast in the morning as the sun wakes you up with a kiss.

Come and lose yourself in this dreamscape—where the mist dances and the mountains call you home.

sections.heading: Guest access
sections.text:
Our treehouse offers a truly immersive experience in nature while providing all the modern comforts. The treehouse is perched amidst lush greenery, giving you privacy and tranquility.

- Arrival & Parking: 🚗
The treehouse is a short 1000-meter walk from the designated parking area, so we recommend packing lightly and using a backpack rather than a suitcase.
  
- Exclusive Areas: 🌳
Guests will have full access to the treehouse, which includes a cozy bedroom, a balcony with stunning valley views, and a private bathroom. The balcony is perfect for soaking in the serenity of nature with a cup of coffee or tea.
  
- Amenities: 🫖
You'll have access to Wi-Fi, a hot water kettle, and all necessary linens. We provide bath products and towels, so no need to bring your own. Additionally, the property offers a bonfire at a small cost of INR 500 for cozy evenings under the stars.
  
- Additional Features: 👣
We can also arrange special activities, such as guided nature walks or fruit picking, upon request. 

We strive to create a peaceful, eco-friendly environment for our guests, so please be mindful of noise levels and help us preserve the natural beauty of this location.

In the quiet hills of Tandi, where the mountains touch the sky and the clouds whisper across ancient trees, there lies a treehouse like no other. A glass cuboid suspended between earth and sky, it stands like a vision of some other world—alien, ethereal, and unforgettable. From within its walls, you’re not just in nature; you *become* part of it, held in the arms of mist and morning light, the stars watching you by night.

Key Amenities:

- **King-size Bed**: Sink into luxury as the softest linens wrap around you. With views from every angle, the mountains are your backdrop, whether you're waking to the sunrise or drifting into sleep.
  
- **Glass Walls & Full View**: The treehouse’s glass walls bring the outside in. You’ll wake to misty forests, sleep under a blanket of stars, and live with nature as your closest neighbor.

- **Private Jacuzzi**: Indulge in the outdoor jacuzzi, heated to perfection. Soak with a view of the valley that stretches below like a painter’s canvas, framed by cedar and pine.

- **Wi-Fi**: While the world feels a million miles away, stay connected if you wish. Perfect for those who want to work or stream, while still perched above the clouds.

- **Rain Shower**: Wash away the day’s adventure in a bathroom that’s as much a part of the forest as the trees outside. The rain shower lets you bathe in luxury, with the sky above you.

- **Heating & cool weather**: No matter the season, you’ll be perfectly comfortable. Whether the day is hot or cold, the treehouse adjusts to the weather with ease.

- **Fire Pit**: In the evening, gather around the fire pit, a perfect spot to sip chai and watch the mist roll in as the sky changes colors.

This glass sanctuary is a space between worlds—grounded yet floating, modern yet ancient in its connection to the land. It’s not just a place to stay; it’s a place to be. When the wind sighs through the forest and the first rays of sun hit the glass, you’ll know what it means to truly escape.

Here in the hills of Tandi, time slows down, and in the stillness, something stirs. Come, and find your place above the clouds.

sections.heading: Guest access
sections.text:
Our treehouse offers a truly immersive experience in nature while providing all the modern comforts. The treehouse is perched amidst lush greenery, giving you privacy and tranquility.

- Arrival & Parking: 🚗
The treehouse is a walk from the designated parking area, so we recommend packing lightly and using a backpack rather than a suitcase.
  
- Exclusive Areas: 🌳
Guests will have full access to the treehouse, which includes a cozy bedroom, a balcony with stunning valley views, and a private bathroom. The balcony is perfect for soaking in the serenity of nature with a cup of coffee or tea.
  
- Amenities: 🫖
You'll have access to Wi-Fi, a hot water kettle, and all necessary linens. We provide bath products and towels, so no need to bring your own. Additionally, the property offers a bonfire at a small cost of INR 500 for cozy evenings under the stars.
  
- Additional Features: 👣
We can also arrange special activities, such as guided nature walks or fruit picking, upon request. 

We strive to create a peaceful, eco-friendly environment for our guests, so please be mindful of noise levels and help us preserve the natural beauty of this location.

sections.heading: Other things to note
sections.text:
🌼Please be nice to everyone in the village, it feels good to host good people.

🌼Please note that last 4-5kms are a little bumpy. Please bring a car with good ground clearance. Last 15kms can be 

🌼You will have to trek to come to our treehouse and even though it can be a 8-9 minute trek, it is not a very very easy one either.

🌼 Other Things to Note
This treehouse is nestled in a quiet Himachali village, surrounded by nature and peace.

🌼Power outages are rare, but they do happen occasionally—we’re prepared with an inverter backup to keep the essentials running.

🌼Please do not expect very luxurious things like bubble bath etc because those things are hard to get in a place like Tandi.

🌼Meals can be served either in the treehouse or at our quaint little café—just let us know what you prefer.

🌼Decor setups (like birthdays, anniversaries, or surprises) are absolutely possible—just give us a heads-up. (P.S. Custom cakes are available but can be expensive in Himachal due to logistics and quality sourcing.)

🌼Food prices here are slightly higher than the plains, as most ingredients are brought in from afar. But we promise it’s made with love and warmth.

🌼We love hosting people—if there’s anything you need, want, or dream of, just say the word. We’ll try our best to make it happen.

This place isn’t just a stay—it’s a feeling. Come as you are, and leave a little more in love—with nature, with someone, or maybe with yourself.

location.subtitle: Anjuna, Goa, India
location.summary: A lively night market, quiet rice fields, and Portuguese influences shape this North Goa neighborhood of village lanes and resort stays.
location.neighborhood:
Artjuna (Arjuna) Café – A Creative Sanctuary
Artjuna is a unique “four-in-one” creative and culinary hub—combining a café, bakery, library, art boutique, and lifestyle store—all within a rustic, serene garden setting in Anjuna 
The café serves fresh, healthy Mediterranean and Middle Eastern-inspired fare including brunch options, vegan bowls, fresh juices, and more—all at affordable pricing (around ₹700–₹1,500 per person depending on variety).


Romeo Lane – A Party Gem in Anjuna 
Located just a next to the property.

Anjuna provides the perfect blend of Goa’s free-spirited charm, cultural layers, and tourist buzz. Artjuna adds an artistic, laid-back sanctuary within that vibe—ideal for day visits or creative spirits. When the sun starts to set, Romeo Lane amplifies the energy with a lively, scenic party experience just down the road.
Want help finding transportation options, lodging nearby, or crafting an itinerary weaving through these spots and beyond? I’ve got you covered!
location.getting_around:
Anjuna is well-connected yet best explored at a relaxed pace. Here’s how to move around:
Scooter & Bike Rentals 🛵 – The most popular choice for visitors. Rentals start at around ₹300–₹500/day, giving you flexibility to explore hidden beaches, markets, and nearby nightlife at your own pace.
Taxis & App-Based Cabs 🚖 – Local taxis are available, but fares can be higher compared to scooter rentals. App services like GoaMiles are more affordable and transparent.
Walking & Cycling 🚶‍♀️🚲 – Many cafes, markets, and beach spots in Anjuna are within short walking distance, especially if you’re staying central. Some guesthouses also offer bicycles.
Car Rentals 🚙 – Great for groups or day trips to farther beaches and forts. Expect ₹1,500–₹2,500/day depending on the model.
Public Transport 🚌 – Limited in frequency and comfort; best for budget travelers with time to spare.

💡 Tip: Night travel is best done via taxis or bikes if you’re confident riding in the dark—Goa’s roads can be narrow and dimly lit.

sections.heading: Guest access
sections.text:
Guests have full private access to the entire villa, including:

✿ All four bedrooms and attached bathrooms
✿ Private indoor living and dining spaces
✿ Fully equipped kitchen for self-cooking or private chef use
✿ Your own private Jacuzzi
✿ Shared access to the swimming pool within the villa complex
✿ On-site parking space

We’ll provide a secure check-in process and will be available for any support throughout your stay. Whether it’s booking a taxi, recommending beach clubs, or arranging housekeeping at your preferred time — we’re just a call away.

Please note that there are no geysers in this house, only solar geysers. There is hot water but on rainy days, the solar might not give the hottest water.

sections.heading: Other things to note
sections.text:
✿ Please treat the villa like your own home — with care and respect.
✿ Daily housekeeping is available, but timing may vary depending on availability. Let us know your preference.
✿ The Jacuzzi is quite old and has not been upgraded in a long time.
✿ The dining table chairs have not been dry cleaned. Some minor areas in the villa may have a bit of dust or dirt please don’t take this too seriously.
✿ Guests are requested t inform us, if additional guests plan to stay overnight or visit for a few hours.
✿ The swimming pool is shared with other villas in the complex. Please be considerate to other guests when using it.
✿ Only tame Pets are allowed, but please ensure they are well-behaved and do not cause damage.
✿ Smoking is allowed, but strictly outside or in designated areas. Any indoor damage or strong odors may incur charges. Smoking inside will cost you INR5000/- fine. If any sofa is burnt or damaged, you will have to pay for the repair or replacement. 
✿ Be mindful with glassware — broken or missing items will be charged.
✿Please do not steal the things we have put in the house. 

We hope you have a comfortable, memorable, and joyful stay!
